# Macworld — Mac conversion reaches duplication

- Original source: [Robin Hood to ship by early Dec.](https://www.macworld.com/article/173354/robinhood-2.html)
- Author / publication: Peter Cohen; Macworld.
- Language / date: English; 2004-11-18.
- Access: Full article retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete factual notes (commercial news item, not transcribed)

Cohen reports that e.p.i.c. interactive’s Mac conversion has reached gold master and entered duplication, with shipping expected within two weeks. The article distinguishes European distribution by e.p.i.c. from United States distribution by Freeverse.

It lists historical requirements of a 300 MHz G3, Mac OS X 10.2, 128 MB RAM, and 8 MB VRAM, and points to a playable demo. This documents manufacturing status and an anticipated shipping window, not confirmation that stores actually received the game on that schedule.

## Detailed notes

Page facts: title "Robin Hood to ship by early Dec."; byline Peter Cohen; section News; dated Nov 18, 2004; retrieved directly from macworld.com (page now carries a 2026 FoundryCo copyright and affiliate-link disclaimer). Three-paragraph news article; commercial content, not transcribed.

- German Mac game developer and publisher e.p.i.c. interactive announced "on Friday" (relative to the Nov 18, 2004 publication) that its conversion of Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood had gone gold master.
- The game is "now in duplication" and expected to ship to stores "within the next two weeks".
- Origin: first a PC game from Spellbound; published in the United States in 2002 by Strategy First.
- Description: squad-based real-time strategy; player controls Robin Hood and the Merry Men against Prince John Lackland in 12th-century England.
- Content figures given: "more than 30 missions", "five different environments and different weather conditions", "nine different characters" controllable at various points, each with unique abilities.
- Distribution: e.p.i.c. distributes in Europe; Freeverse Software handles United States distribution (link to freeverse.com/robinhood/).
- Price: US$29.95.
- System requirements: G3/300MHz or faster, Mac OS X v10.2 or higher, 128MB RAM, 8MB VRAM.
- A playable demo is available for download (link to macgamefiles.com, item 18371).

Note: the mission figure here ("more than 30") differs from the "over 40" in 2002 PC publicity; both are publisher claims as reported.
